name: Tamamo-no-Mae
description: A front-facing anime cutout mesh with a real weighted armature. The source painting is the UV texture; the mesh silhouette is edge-keyed from the T-pose. Nine independently weighted six-bone tails, hands, fingers, ears, hair, limbs, and torso are animated in Blender.
spell_effects: Godot BattleFX nodes, independent of the character texture and action clips.
